hero.title: Together, Making
hero.label: Conservation Possible
hero.text: Oceans Alive's work relies on partnership, philanthropy and community collaboration. The results and impact presented across this website have been achieved together with the institutions and people below, each of whom contributes to making this work possible.

allPartnersOrganizedByCategory.heading: Community & Resource-User Institutions
allPartnersOrganizedByCategory.text: Community-led action is central to Oceans Alive's identity
allPartnersOrganizedByCategory.text2: Oceans Alive depends on grant funding and donor support to do this work, and we acknowledge that support openly.

becomeAPartner.heading: Work With Us
becomeAPartner.text: We collaborate with NGOs, research institutions, governments, media organizations, and responsible businesses who share our commitment to community-led conservation.
